svg.title: Skills and where they are used
svg.desc: Skills, each with the projects that use it. Languages: C++17/20 (PitchFork, Band-Former), Go (k8n), Python (sample-platform, Band-Former), TypeScript and JavaScript (PitchFork, sample-platform, k8n, Undercover), SQL (sample-platform, k8n), Bash (PitchFork, sample-platform); Systems and performance: Linux (PitchFork), Benchmarking and profiling (PitchFork), WebAssembly (PitchFork); AI and ML: PyTorch (Band-Former), MCP and LLM tool calling (k8n); Backend and web: REST APIs and OpenAPI (sample-platform), Flask and FastAPI (sample-platform, Band-Former), Gin (k8n), Express and Socket.IO (Undercover), React (sample-platform, Undercover), Next.js (k8n); Data: MySQL (sample-platform), PostgreSQL (k8n), Redis (Undercover); Infrastructure: Docker (sample-platform, k8n, Band-Former), Kubernetes and Helm (k8n)
